facts.activity_file: applying locks, tags and personal danger tags

control_failures.control_label: identification of every energy source for the task
controlled removal of isolation and return to service
mechanical support of a load during maintenance access
parking, chocking and restraint of equipment
application of positive isolation devices and personal locks

hazard_media: stored potential of an elevated component
facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: uncontrolled movement of ML-3201 during transfer operations

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 4 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control ENERGY_SOURCE_IDENTIFICATION: the identification of every energy source for the task was never verified as effective, and the learning team review classified this as an individual or team action.

Control ISOLATION_HANDBACK_CONTROL: the controlled removal of isolation and return to service was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as an organisational factor.
Control LOAD_SUPPORT_FOR_MAINTENANCE: the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access had been bypassed, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control PARK_UP_AND_RESTRAINT: the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control POSITIVE_ISOLATION_APPLICATION: the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access on ML-3201 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
Restore the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment on ML-3201 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
Restore the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks on ML-3201 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in applying and verifying an isolation, specifically applying locks, tags and personal danger tags. ML-3201 (grinding mills) is in service for two-line ball milling. The task proceeded during transfer operations while the identification of every energy source for the task was never verified as effective. The gravity energy involved is held as suspended load, and the recorded presentation was fall, collapse, crush.
response.summary: On 7 July 2022 an incident occurred on ML-3201 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during transfer operations, releasing gravity energy held as suspended load.
